title: Roadmaps with confidence intervals, and the conversation about dates

videos.script: The director of sales wants to tell the shops the new invoicing screen will be ready for the fair on the sixth of November. {{fair}} The team's history says the end of October, if nothing grows. But this kind of work always grows. {{grows}} Allowing for that, the safe date is the middle of November. The sixth is a coin toss. {{coin}} There are three things in every conversation about dates. The scope, the date, and the confidence. {{levers}} You can fix two of them. Never all three. {{two}} This lesson turns forecasts into sentences people can plan around. It draws roadmaps that admit what they do not know. {{roadmaps}} It adds the growing work to the simulation. And it follows that conversation with the director, move by move. {{conversation}} The aim is not to win it. The aim is to make the risk a decision somebody takes, instead of a surprise somebody gets. {{decision}}
